caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden kitchen cabinet positioned centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The cabinet is rendered in shades of brown and tan, with the wood grain texture visible throughout its surfaces. The cabinet features a rectangular structure with a slightly protruding top section bordered by a raised, tray-like edge along three sides, forming a shallow enclosure. Below the tray, there is a narrow horizontal drawer with two round knobs, and beneath the drawer is a single door with a rectangular panel in the center, also fitted with a knob. The outline and details are defined by thin, precise lines accentuating the edges, panels, and joints of the furniture. There are light shadows cast to the left and behind the cabinet, indicating a light source from the front right. The background is otherwise empty, and the cabinet occupies the central part of the composition.
title: Shaker Kitchen Piece with Tray
